GEOGRAPHY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

2. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

4. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.
   D. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   B. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.

6. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Vulcanicity is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vulcanicity with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vulcanicity.
   C. Say Vulcanicity never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vulcanicity as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

11. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   C. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.

13. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Treat Mining as rumours only.
   D. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.

14. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Mombasa
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

15. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Treat Folding as rumours only.
   C. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Rocks and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Mining and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Energy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Industry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Geography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
